newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-QBE offers to take on MLC policies.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-QBE offers to take on MLC policies.

text.p: QBE Insurance Ltd said on Tuesday it would offer to take on current general insurance customers of Lend Lease Corp's MLC Insurance Ltd, producing an expected annual gross premium of A$45 million.
Lend Lease said in November its MLC insurance and funds management division would withdraw from the general insurance sector at the end of calendar 1996.

QBE managing director John Cloney said in a statement QBE had agreed with MLC to offer to insure current MLC customers on expiry of their existing policies and would accept new business enquiries from MLC customers.
"MLC will honour all existing policies held by its customers," he said.
"Annual gross premium from the MLC portfolio is expected to produce A$45 million," he said.
